MEASURED, NOT RANKED: every record's design file of the task synthesized by the pinned scoring flow (score/ppa.py, sky130 flow A0') at the sizes of leaderboard/sizes.json; the board ranks the scoring size (`scored`) alone, where every column equals the record's own (checked). `at` maps a size key to the sky130 columns: area_e4um2 (1e-4 um^2), area_um2, delay_ps (the critical-path delay; on a clocked task the register-to-register period), cycles (clocked: the design's proved latency at that size; null on a combinational task), time_ps (delay, or cycles x period), area_x_time (area_e4um2 x time_ps, 1e-4 um^2 x ps), the GE columns, the cell count, the netlist hashes and the run's wall-clock seconds; `asap7` the ASAP7 view's cells-only columns on the same netlist (area_e5um2 in 1e-5 um^2). A size that was not measured says why (`limit`: the run's time or memory limit, `pins.limits`; `flow`: the flow refused it). The routed course is not measured at other sizes. See leaderboard/README.md, "Other sizes".
